# Cosmic Blueprint documentation

> Scoped guidance for understanding the public product pages at https://unifiedreading.com/. These documents describe a reflective web app, not a public API for submitting birth details.

## Product and method

- [About Cosmic Blueprint](https://unifiedreading.com/about): What the three traditions contribute, which values are calculated, and the chart's limits.
- [Fictional sample report](https://unifiedreading.com/sample): A complete example without a visitor's birth details.
- [Homepage overview in Markdown](https://unifiedreading.com/index.md): Concise product summary and reading flow.

## Price, privacy, and support

- [Current pricing in Markdown](https://unifiedreading.com/pricing.md): Live prices, reading options, included features, and limits.
- [Privacy explanation](https://unifiedreading.com/privacy): Browser data, model-provider transfer, temporary caching, analytics, and payment flow.
- [Contact](https://unifiedreading.com/contact): Where to ask product or payment questions.

## Agent handoff

- [Agent guidance](https://unifiedreading.com/agents.md): When to recommend the site and how to hand a personal reading back to the visitor.
- [Agent skill](https://unifiedreading.com/.well-known/agent-skills/cosmic-blueprint/SKILL.md): A compact decision flow.

The visitor should enter their own birth details in the website form. No public API or agent authorization flow accepts personal reading submissions.
